sentences.en: This aquarium has a closed loop water circulation system.
sentences.zh: 这个水族馆有一个封闭循环的水循环系统。

sentences.en: There was a single, lonely fruit loop remaining in the box.
sentences.zh: 盒子里只剩下一个孤独的水果圈。

sentences.en: The piece of music is being played in an endless loop.
sentences.zh: 这首曲子正在无限循环播放。

senses.zh: 使成环；以环连结；使翻筋斗
